roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Agentic Experiences (Former Engineer)

bullets: Own the enterprise adoption problem space end to end: the procurement, security, compliance, and UX storylines that have to work together to win upmarket deals.
Set strategy, sequencing across enterprise initiatives which today includes SSO, compliance readiness, and our Console UX, and defend that prioritization with data.
Ship solutions on whatever surface fits the problem: Console, APIs, or the managed endpoint. You own the problem and partner with the PMs who own those surfaces rather than owning…
Drive enterprise security and compliance readiness so procurement teams can self-serve e.g., SBOM generation and security-artifact access, instead of waiting on us.
Remove the product blockers that stall deals in security review and slow closure.
